?Court No. - 93
Case :- Criminal Appeal No. - 4574 of 2022
Appellant :- Bhisham Pal
Respondent :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Appellant :- Vipin Kumar,Mukesh Kumar Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
Heard Sri Gauri Shanker, Advocate, holding brief of Sri Mukesh Kumar, learned counsel for the appellant, Sri Sunil Kumar Tripathi, learned A.G.A. for the State, and perused the record.
Notice on respondent no. 2 has been sufficiently served.

The present criminal appeal under Section 14-A(2) of the Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 has been filed against the order dated 25.05.2022 passed by Special Judge, (S.C./S/.T. Act), Firozabad, whereby the learned Judge has rejected the Bail Application No. 1707 of 2022 (Bhisham Pal Vs. State of U.P.) moved on behalf of the appellant in Case Crime No. 77 of 2022 under Sections 323, 376 I.P.C. and Section 3(2)V of S.C./S.T. (P.A.) Act,
Police Station- Eka, District- Firozabad.

sentences.text: According to prosecution case on 18.03.2022 at 4 p.m. when the informant/victim was preparing meal in her home, appellant-accused, Bhisham Pal, who resided in her neighborhood, entered into the house of the informant.
He sent informant's son, Ajit, to market to bring spices.
The appellant-accused forcibly put the victim on the cot and committed rape on her due to which she became unconscious.

When informant/victim became conscious, she called her husband and Bhisham Pal vs State Of U.P. And Another on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94516883/
1 narrated to him about the incident.

entities.text: Bhisham Pal vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In case he is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.

Per contra, learned A.G.A. for the State has opposed the prayer for bail of the appellant on the ground that in the medical examination report of the victim, possibility of sexual assault cannot be ruled out.

It has also been submitted that informant/victim has supported the prosecution case in her statements recorded u/s 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.
Considering the submissions made on behalf of the learned counsel for the appellant and learned A.G.A., facts and circumstances of the case, statements of the informant/victim u/s 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. and that of other witnesses u/s 161 Cr.P.C., medical examination report of the victim, but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the appellant-accused at this stage.
The bail application is rejected.

Accordingly, the appeal is disposed of with the direction to trial court to conclude the trial of the case as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of one year from the date of filing of certified copy of this order before the court concerned, if there is no legal impediment.

The observations made in this order is only for the purpose of bail and it shall not impact the proceedings of the trial court while deciding the case on merits.
Order Date :- 21.2.2023
